messages:
Asha: FYI hitting a painful mypy/pyright error in the Python sample app on fresh SDK install. Autogenerated client + models mismatch for optional fields in async streams.
Tom: can you paste the tiny snippet that fails?
Asha: sure, minimal repro below. note the stream yields items where a nested field can be missing at runtime.
```py
from typing import Optional, AsyncIterator, Dict
from pydantic import BaseModel

class Event(BaseModel):
    id: str
    attrs: Optional[Dict[str, str]] = None

async def consume(client):
    async for ev in client.events_stream():
        # mypy complains here: \"Item \\\"None\\\" of \\\"Optional[Dict[str, str]]\\\" has no attribute \\\"items\\\"\"
        for k, v in ev.attrs.items():
            pass
```
Asha: mypy output:
```
main.py:9: error: Item "None" of "Optional[Dict[str, str]]" has no attribute "items"  [attr-defined]
Found 1 error in 1 file (checked 1 source file)
```
Lorenzo: is the pyi stub for events_stream typed as AsyncIterator[Event] or AsyncIterator[Optional[Event]]?
Asha: stub says AsyncIterator[Event], runtime sometimes yields Event instances where attrs==None. pydantic gives None default, but the stub doesn't reflect Optional on that inner field (or the stream yields Optional[event] in some builds).
Tom: two separate mismatch vectors we need to consider: 1) per-model field optionality in generated pyi, and 2) streaming protocol that sometimes emits "heartbeat" None wrappers. We've seen both cause pyright/myppy churn.
Lorenzo: quick fixes for sampleapp: add a defensive guard or use `assert ev.attrs is not None` before iterating. But that's noisy for users doing strict type checks.
Asha: new users run mypy --strict as part of onboarding templates and fail immediately which kills confidence.
build-bot: CI:autogen-stubs failed mypy-suite (see https://ci.example/runner/567) :warning:
Tom: proposal: change generator to always mark model fields with default None as Optional[...] in .pyi; also add an audit pass for stream return types that can be Optional.
Lorenzo: +1. Also add an opt-in flag in generator config to prefer TypedDict vs BaseModel in stubs, and document runtime differences. Some downstream projects rely on isinstance checks.
Asha: can we add a small integration test in the autogen pipeline that runs mypy & pyright against a sampleapp using the generated stubs? Catch regressions early.
Tom: yep, will add a mypy/pyright check step and a tiny sample that iterates streams with Optional inner fields and expects no errors.
Lorenzo: for immediate onboarding, let's ship a `mypy.ini` in sampleapp with recommended flags (not --strict) and a short README note: "defensive iteration pattern". docs-bot: opened docs PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/412 to add a troubleshooting section on SDK typing annoyances.
Asha: I'll drop the failing repro and the CI link in the new SDK issue so the autogen team can reproduce. Thanks all. :raised_hands:
